title: seed: an unkeyed (insert/replace) inline seed is inserted again on every un-walled start, so the first row's person references stay NULL and the dataset duplicates
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPJxG4vBVaLCBWLcWJ

Filing gate ①: class a (reproduced), from the L1 review 6936354630 on PR #34581 (card #34542), R1/R2, measured by the card thread and passed on by area `o2-A`. PR #34581 pins only the keyed modes and keeps `Fixes #34542`; this card holds the unkeyed remainder.

Suggested-grade: p2 · class a (reproduced) · domain:spec / metadata-protocol seed loader · reach: named producer, the un-walled inline boot seed (`AppPlugin` runs it on every start)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：未开组织隔离墙的安装，每次启动都重放内联种子。数据集是 `insert` 或 `replace` 模式时，重放不按键找旧行，每次启动都再插一行。种子第 1 次落库时人员引用(要等第一个管理员或某个人注册才能补)留空，重启后补上的是新插的那一行，第一次那行永远是空的，而且数据重复。如果该字段带唯一约束，第二次插入被库拒绝，那一行也永远补不上。
- 影响范围：只影响 `insert` / `replace` 模式的种子数据集，带键模式(ignore 默认、upsert、update)不受影响(PR #34581 已钉住)。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Evidence (measured)

Two-boot probe over one SQLite file (`bootStack({ databaseFile })`), un-walled, `origin/main` 1e4656d01 product code. One record `{ name: 'Late task', assignee: 'Late Person', reviewer: 'Late Person' }`; the person signs up only in the second process.

| dataset | after boot 1 | after boot 2 | after the sign-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode: 'insert'`, `externalId: 'name'` | 1 row, NULL/NULL | 2 rows | first row NULL/NULL; new row names the person |
| `mode: 'insert'`, no `externalId` | 1 row | 2 rows | same as above |
| `mode: 'replace'` | 1 row | 2 rows | same as above |
| `insert` / `replace`, `name` `unique: true` | 1 row | 1 row; the insert refused (`UNIQUE constraint failed: seedowner_task.organization_id, seedowner_task.name`, at `warn`) | the one row stays NULL/NULL |
| control: `upsert` / `ignore` | 1 row | same row id | the first row names the person |

## Seam

`seed-loader.ts` `loadDataset`: `keyedMode = mode === 'upsert' || mode === 'update' || mode === 'ignore'`; only then is `existingRecords` read. `decideWriteAction`: `insert` / `replace` always answer `insert`. `SeedMode` (`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`) documents `insert` as "each replay inserts them again". `AppPlugin` runs the inline seed on every un-walled start (no first-boot-only gate).

Whether the fix is in the loader (an unkeyed replay of a landed dataset), in the boot (when an unkeyed dataset replays), or in authoring (`insert` on an inline boot seed refused or warned) is the claiming seat's call; it may touch the `SeedMode` contract.

## Dedupe words

Searched open and closed cards; related, not duplicates: #30081 (closed decision: a restart overwrites edits to seeded rows), #34406 (open decision: managed-upgrade replay of new seed keys).


`seed insert mode replay duplicate`, `inline seed every boot insert`, `seed replace replay restart`, `held person reference insert mode`

Source: L1 review 6936354630 on PR #34581 (card #34542), R1/R2.
